summary: YC's AI Stack gives students who attend an eligible YC event (starting Fall 2025) over $25,000 in free credits for AI tools and cloud services, with the deals page listing $5,000 on AWS (down from $10,000 as of 2026-10-28), $1,000 OpenAI and $500 Anthropic, plus credits from YC-company devtools such as Firecrawl, Exa, Vapi, Browser Use, Reducto and Gumloop. Access lasts one year from the qualifying event. The 2025 launch blog also mentioned Azure credits, but Azure is not listed on the current deals page.
claim_steps: Attend an eligible YC event (Fall 2025 onward), RSVPing with your Hacker News account
Watch for the confirmation email after the event
Sign in at deals.ycombinator.com/students with the same Hacker News account to check eligibility
Check each partner's current amount after sign-in: on 2026-10-28 the page listed AWS at $5,000 (previously $10,000) and no Azure deal.
Browse and redeem each partner deal
